goal: Maintainer can classify failures into product, test, environment, flaky, blocker, or requirement categories.

acceptance_ownership.AC-06: Task 018 contributes first-failure evidence; Task 020 owns complete attempt history.
acceptance_ownership.AC-25: Task 018 contributes the frozen packet; Task 019 owns Development task creation and routing.
acceptance_ownership.AC-27: Task 018 contributes break_loop_required only; Task 020 and Core own governance and lifecycle transitions.

non_goals: Do not expand beyond this vertical slice or complete dependent tasks implicitly.
Do not add fallback, verification light mode, manual green overrides, or business-project package mutations.
Do not overwrite failed attempts, raw evidence, or unrelated downstream worktree changes.
expected_evidence: A focused failing test or fixture before the implementation change
System-executed command output with exit status
Task report, spec review, and quality review before checkbox completion
Blocked review RED and superseding GREEN evidence for open packets, exact assertion/evidence sets, and timestamp-bound packet identity
Direct evidence for the frozen failure packet and all six classifications; contribution evidence for AC-06, AC-25, and AC-27
unsafe_assumptions: Tool availability is not runtime readiness.
Model interpretation is not a deterministic oracle.
Report HTML is not the release gate source.
Legacy V1 status is not V2 proof.
stop_condition: Stop when dependencies 015-reading-model, 016-six-domain-aggregation are incomplete, scope or contract evidence is missing, a required dependency is unavailable, or shared kernel behavior would be duplicated.
